title: A superyacht eats 10% of its price every year
description: The purchase price of a superyacht is the one number people quote. It is also the smallest number involved. Here is what it actually costs to keep one floating for twelve months.

scenes.narration: Every year, a superyacht eats ten percent of its own price.
scenes.imagePrompt: Aerial drone view of a single sleek 80-meter white superyacht cruising alone across dark open water at dusk, modern motor yacht with curved glass superstructure and sun deck, long white wake behind it, moody overcast sky

scenes.narration: You pay a hundred and fifty million for the boat. Then fifteen million more, every year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close macro of the polished teak deck of a luxury motor yacht meeting a gleaming stainless steel yacht railing, edge of a white sun lounger just in frame, calm sea beyond, golden hour light raking across the wood grain, shallow focus

scenes.narration: Around forty crew live on board. Their salaries alone run four million a year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Narrow crew corridor inside a superyacht, glossy white painted joinery with pale wood trim, row of identical closed cabin doors with polished chrome handles, low ceiling, warm recessed downlights, deep one-point perspective, no people

scenes.narration: At cruising speed she burns five hundred liters of fuel every hour.
scenes.imagePrompt: Immaculate superyacht engine room, two large marine engines in gleaming white and polished chrome, spotless painted floor, neat color-coded pipework and gauges, bright clean lighting, luxury yacht engineering space, no people

scenes.narration: A berth on the Mediterranean coast can cost ten thousand dollars a night in peak season.
scenes.imagePrompt: Night detail of an empty luxury marina berth, thick mooring lines and polished steel cleats filling the foreground on wet wooden dock boards, blurred white hull sides and harbour lights far behind and out of focus, no transom, no signage, no people

scenes.narration: Insurance takes about one percent of the hull value before she has left the dock.
scenes.imagePrompt: Detail of the glossy white hull of a luxury motor yacht curving into dark calm water, crisp painted waterline stripe and mirror reflection, cold blue tones, minimal abstract composition

scenes.narration: Every five years she goes into a shipyard, and a full refit can reach twenty million.
scenes.imagePrompt: A white superyacht hauled out in a refit yard photographed head-on from directly in front of the bow at night, the bow stem rising above padded steel cradles, work lamps glowing behind, hull sides receding out of frame, no signage, no people

scenes.narration: So the hardest part of owning her was never writing that first check.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single white superyacht anchored alone in a dark bay at night, one warm lit salon window glowing, faint coastline lights far in the distance, vast calm black sea, wide vertical framing
